::: {#rem-negation-procedure}
#### Pushing a negation inward

To negate a proposition built with $\neg$, $\land$, $\lor$, $\Rightarrow$ and quantifiers,
move the $\neg$ inward one step at a time:

- across a quantifier, with @thm-negate-quantifiers, which swaps $\forall$ and $\exists$;
- across $\land$ or $\lor$, with De Morgan's laws (@thm-de-morgan-logic);
- across $\Rightarrow$, with @thm-negate-conditional;
- across another $\neg$, with double negation (@thm-double-negation).

Stop when every $\neg$ sits in front of a proposition with no connective or quantifier inside it.
The result is easier to read and to check than a $\neg$ in front of the whole proposition.

:::
